detail: 6 of 570 green skills are absent from the original ESCOX skills.csv (different ESCO release). They are fully supported in ESCOX 3.0 because the green module embeds the supplied green-skill file directly.

The crosswalk lists 706 NACE codes at mixed levels ({'class': 424, 'group': 219, 'division': 54, 'section': 9}). Titles of 103 parent codes (including 13 sections) are not present in the supplied file. ESCOX 3.0 shows those parent codes without a title rather than inventing one. Import the official Eurostat NACE Rev. 2.1 structure to complete the hierarchy (python -m escox3 import-nace <csv>).

No green-occupation definition or occupation-skill relation file was supplied. The supplied files contain green SKILLS (greenSkillsCollection_en.csv) and an occupation->NACE crosswalk, but nothing that labels ESCO occupations or ISCO groups as green. ESCOX 3.0 therefore identifies occupations and their verified ISCO-08 codes, but reports their green status as 'undetermined' instead of guessing. To enable it, place the official ESCO download occupationSkillRelations_en.csv (same ESCO release as the crosswalk, v1.2) in escox3/data/raw/ and run `python -m escox3 build-reference`, or import an authoritative green-occupation list with `python -m escox3 import-green-occupations <csv>`.
greenSkillsCollection_en.csv does not state its ESCO release; the crosswalk states ESCO 1.2. Record the release used in publications.
